chapter.chapter: Chapter 5 — Measurement of Length and Motion

excerpts:
[NSEJS 2015 — question paper]
9. A particle moves along the x-axis according to the equation x = 6t where x is displacement 2
in meters and t is time in seconds. Therefore
a) the acceleration of the particle is 6 ms -2
b) the particle follows a parabolic path
c) each second the velocity of the particle changes by 9.8 ms -1
d) the velocity of the particle is 6 ms at t = 0.5 s -1

[INJSO 2013 — question paper]
60. A 100 m sprinter increases her speed from rest uniformly at the rate of 1 m/s upto 2
40 m and covers the remaining distance with uniform speed. The sprinter covers the
first half of the run in t 1 s and the second half in t 2 s. Then:
A. t 1 > t 2
B. t < t 1 2
C. t = t 1 2
D. information given is incomplete.

[INJSO 2011 — question paper]
34. Velocity time graph of four athletes for a given interval of time are as given below. Who has
travelled maximum distance?
a) A b) B c) C d) D

[INJSO 2016 — question paper]
39.
Two projectiles are fired simultaneously from ground level with same initial speed (u). Both
cover same horizontal distance of 160 m on reaching the ground level. One of them reaches 6
sec. prior to the other. Only gravitational acceleration g = 10 m/s governs the motion of both 2
the projectiles. Calculate (u).
[Total = 5 marks]
